Sahuagin Baron

Large Humanoid (Sahuagin), Lawful Evil
Saving ThrowsDex +5, Con +6, Int +5, Wis +4
SkillsPerception +7
Sensesdarkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 17
LanguagesSahuagin
Challenge5 (1,800 XP)
Traits
Blood Frenzy.

The sahuagin has Advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature that doesn't have all its Hit Points.

Limited Amphibiousness.

The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

Shark Telepathy.

The sahuagin can magically command any shark within 120 feet of itself, using a limited telepathy.

Actions
Multiattack.

The sahuagin makes three attacks: one Bite attack and two Claws or Trident attacks.

Bite.

Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Piercing damage.

Claws.

Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

Trident.

Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, or 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.
